title: svarknet
tagline: We've built a starter app for Starknet, using Svelte and ArgentX.
description: We've built a starter app for Starknet. We wanted to try out Svelte in the frontend, and test out a layer 2. We decided to explore ZK rollups and after some research we went with Starknet. Overall this was just a small experiment to explore some technologies we were not familiar with. We also used ArgentX wallet.
